preconditions.description: The input string s is non-empty and its length does not exceed 5,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase English letters.
The integer k is at least 1 and at most the length of s.

postconditions.description: The output string is the lexicographically smallest among all strings obtainable by partitioning s into m parts (1 <= m <= k), optionally reversing any subset of those parts, and concatenating them in order.
The length of the output string equals the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in result)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of lowercase English letters.
